name: Approach 2 - AI Opportunity Scanner, zero-shot (no data grounding)
protocol: Generated by the LLM (Claude Opus 5.5) from parametric knowledge only, BEFORE any data was gathered for this run. Prompt: 'Act as an AI opportunity scanner for banking and finance. List 30 novel, useful, patentable invention concepts. For each give title, problem, mechanism, and search keywords.' Frozen and hashed before Approach 1 data collection began, so it is an uncontaminated baseline.

ideas.title: Coercion-aware transfer friction
ideas.problem: Authorised push payment (APP) scams: victims are coached live by a scammer on the phone while they make the transfer.
ideas.mechanism: Detect concurrent active voice call, navigation hesitancy, copy-pasted payee details and first-time payee; dynamically insert a cooling-off delay and a callback to a pre-registered trusted contact who must confirm with a safe word.
ideas.keywords: authorized push payment scam detection active call coaching cooling-off trusted contact

ideas.title: Bounded-intent mandates for AI shopping agents
ideas.problem: AI agents that pay on a user's behalf can overspend or be prompt-injected into paying the wrong merchant.
ideas.mechanism: User signs a machine-verifiable spending policy (merchant category, price ceiling, time window, item class); the network token carries a policy hash and the issuer verifies a policy-compliance proof on every agent-initiated authorisation.
ideas.keywords: AI agent payment mandate spending policy tokenization issuer verification agentic commerce

ideas.title: Critical-slowing-down deposit-run early warning
ideas.problem: Digital bank runs (e.g. SVB 2023) unfold in hours, faster than supervisory liquidity monitoring.
ideas.mechanism: Compute rolling autocorrelation and variance of intraday deposit outflows by segment (early-warning signals of a phase transition), fuse with social-media sentiment velocity, and automatically pre-position collateral at the central bank discount window when the combined index crosses a threshold.
ideas.keywords: bank run early warning critical slowing down deposit outflow social media sentiment liquidity collateral

ideas.title: Zero-knowledge income attestation from bank sessions
ideas.problem: Lenders demand full bank statements, exposing far more data than needed.
ideas.mechanism: zkTLS proof generated over the user's live online-banking session proves 'average monthly income > X for 6 months' without revealing transactions; lender verifies proof against bank's TLS certificate.
ideas.keywords: zero knowledge proof income verification TLS bank statement privacy lending

ideas.title: Shelf-life-weighted post-quantum migration planner
ideas.problem: Banks cannot migrate all cryptography to PQC at once; harvest-now-decrypt-later threatens long-lived data.
ideas.mechanism: Network scanner fingerprints TLS/HSM/key usage, tags each flow with the confidentiality shelf-life of the data it carries, and computes a migration order that minimises quantum-exposure = shelf-life x traffic volume x algorithm weakness.
ideas.keywords: post-quantum cryptography migration inventory harvest now decrypt later prioritization bank

ideas.title: Mule-network epidemiology (R0 for money mules)
ideas.problem: Money-mule recruitment spreads socially; banks close accounts one at a time.
ideas.mechanism: Estimate a reproduction number for mule recruitment from temporal transaction graphs, identify superspreader recruiter accounts, and prioritise interventions to push R below 1.
ideas.keywords: money mule network reproduction number epidemiology transaction graph superspreader

ideas.title: Ultrasonic liveness nonce for voice-channel authentication
ideas.problem: Voice deepfakes defeat call-centre voice biometrics.
ideas.mechanism: During a call the bank app on the customer's registered phone emits an inaudible ultrasonic nonce; the call-centre audio stream must contain the acoustic echo of that nonce, proving a live person co-located with the registered device.
ideas.keywords: voice deepfake call center authentication ultrasonic nonce liveness registered device

ideas.title: Sensor-attested programmable escrow for trade finance
ideas.problem: Trade finance relies on paper documents that are easy to forge.
ideas.mechanism: Tokenized deposit escrow releases automatically when IoT sensor attestations (GPS, container seal, temperature) signed by hardware roots of trust satisfy the letter-of-credit conditions.
ideas.keywords: tokenized deposit escrow IoT attestation trade finance letter of credit smart contract

ideas.title: Cash-flow-elastic credit line
ideas.problem: Static credit limits mismatch volatile gig-worker income.
ideas.mechanism: Credit limit recomputed daily from account-aggregator cash-flow forecasts with uncertainty bands; limit follows the lower confidence bound.
ideas.keywords: dynamic credit limit cash flow forecasting account aggregator gig worker

ideas.title: Checkout affordability digital twin
ideas.problem: Customers take on purchases/BNPL they cannot afford.
ideas.mechanism: Simulate the customer's next 90 days of balances with the proposed purchase on a financial digital twin and show probability of overdraft before approval.
ideas.keywords: affordability simulation digital twin checkout overdraft probability BNPL

ideas.title: SKU-level carbon footprint card
ideas.problem: Card carbon trackers use coarse merchant-category averages.
ideas.mechanism: Parse itemised e-receipts linked to card transactions and compute SKU-level emissions.
ideas.keywords: carbon footprint card transaction receipt SKU emissions

ideas.title: Revocable consent tokens with deletion proofs
ideas.problem: Open banking users cannot verify data was deleted after revoking consent.
ideas.mechanism: User-held consent tokens; data recipients must return a signed deletion attestation anchored in a transparency log upon revocation.
ideas.keywords: open banking consent revocation deletion proof transparency log

ideas.title: Cross-chain stablecoin redemption router
ideas.problem: Stablecoin redemption to fiat is fragmented across chains and banks.
ideas.mechanism: Router atomically burns on source chain and settles on instant bank rails, choosing path by liquidity and fees.
ideas.keywords: stablecoin redemption routing cross chain atomic settlement instant payment

ideas.title: Cognitive-decline signals for elder abuse prevention
ideas.problem: Elderly customers with cognitive decline are exploited financially.
ideas.mechanism: Longitudinal drift in digital-banking interaction patterns (navigation errors, typing speed, repeated actions) flags decline; triggers trusted-contact escalation and lower transfer limits.
ideas.keywords: cognitive decline detection banking interaction elder financial abuse trusted contact

ideas.title: Identity-age inconsistency for synthetic ID detection
ideas.problem: Synthetic identities combine real SSNs with fake details.
ideas.mechanism: Compare age of digital footprint (email, phone, device history) with claimed age and credit-file depth; inconsistency score flags synthetic identity.
ideas.keywords: synthetic identity detection digital footprint age inconsistency credit file

ideas.title: MPC cross-bank payee risk consortium
ideas.problem: Fraud intelligence is siloed across banks.
ideas.mechanism: Secure multi-party computation of payee risk scores across banks without revealing customer data.
ideas.keywords: secure multiparty computation fraud consortium payee risk banks

ideas.title: Counterfactual adverse-action notices
ideas.problem: Credit denials must be explained (ECOA/Reg B).
ideas.mechanism: Generate actionable counterfactual explanations with guaranteed feasibility constraints.
ideas.keywords: counterfactual explanation adverse action credit denial

ideas.title: Event-aware ATM cash forecasting
ideas.problem: ATM cash-outs and idle cash.
ideas.mechanism: Forecast using local event calendars and weather.
ideas.keywords: ATM cash demand forecasting events weather

ideas.title: Dispute escrow window for instant payments
ideas.problem: Instant account-to-account payments are irrevocable, fuelling scams.
ideas.mechanism: Optional escrow window where funds are credited but locked, releasable early by payer confirmation or reversed by dispute.
ideas.keywords: instant payment reversible escrow window dispute account to account

ideas.title: Bank-backed metering tokens for AI API micro-payments
ideas.problem: AI agents need to pay per API call.
ideas.mechanism: Prepaid bank-issued metering tokens redeemed per call with batched settlement.
ideas.keywords: micropayment AI agent API metering token settlement

ideas.title: Biometric-bound offline CBDC wallet
ideas.problem: Offline CBDC risks double spending.
ideas.mechanism: Secure-element monotonic counters and biometric binding; reconciliation on reconnection detects double spend.
ideas.keywords: offline CBDC wallet double spending secure element biometric

ideas.title: Life-event-triggered KYC refresh
ideas.problem: Periodic KYC refresh is wasteful.
ideas.mechanism: Infer life events from transactions and refresh KYC only when risk-relevant events occur.
ideas.keywords: perpetual KYC refresh life event trigger

ideas.title: RL-driven financial wellness nudges
ideas.problem: Generic savings nudges are ignored.
ideas.mechanism: Reinforcement learning chooses nudge timing and framing per user.
ideas.keywords: reinforcement learning savings nudge personalization

ideas.title: Cross-script transliteration graph for sanctions screening
ideas.problem: Name transliteration defeats sanctions screening.
ideas.mechanism: Graph of transliteration variants across scripts used for fuzzy matching.
ideas.keywords: sanctions screening transliteration fuzzy name matching scripts

ideas.title: Satellite collateral monitoring for loan covenants
ideas.problem: Collateral monitoring is manual.
ideas.mechanism: Satellite imagery change detection on pledged farms/factories.
ideas.keywords: satellite imagery collateral monitoring loan covenant

ideas.title: Cross-retailer return-fraud linkage
ideas.problem: Serial return fraud spans retailers.
ideas.mechanism: Card-network level linking of refunds across merchants.
ideas.keywords: return fraud refund abuse cross merchant card network

ideas.title: Telco SIM-swap signals for ATO
ideas.problem: SIM swap enables account takeover.
ideas.mechanism: Query telco network APIs for recent SIM swap before OTP delivery.
ideas.keywords: SIM swap detection telco API account takeover OTP

ideas.title: ROSCA participation credit scoring
ideas.problem: Thin-file borrowers lack credit history.
ideas.mechanism: Digitised rotating savings groups produce repayment histories used for credit scoring.
ideas.keywords: ROSCA savings group credit scoring thin file

ideas.title: RTGS gridlock resolution by queue reordering
ideas.problem: Intraday liquidity gridlock.
ideas.mechanism: Optimise payment queue ordering to minimise liquidity needs.
ideas.keywords: RTGS liquidity saving mechanism gridlock queue optimization

ideas.title: Pre-emptive chargeback prediction
ideas.problem: Chargebacks cost merchants.
ideas.mechanism: Predict chargeback probability at authorisation and offer proactive refund.
ideas.keywords: chargeback prediction proactive refund merchant
